description: A VB Studio project in a tab of its own (Build.Rite: Organizations & projects → a project): all its workspaces as VB Studio lists them (workspace, owner, repository, branch, environment, last opened), Refresh workspaces (read again from VB Studio, from inside its own page: desktop/lib/vbs.js sync of that one project), its repositories (Add to Build.Rite), and what the last refresh did.

name.description: Its name as listed (the tab's title).

found.description: What Build.Rite knows from VB Studio (desktop/lib/vbs.js discovered()).

result.description: { ok, text } of the last action.

refresh.description: The last refresh on this tab: { at, ok, error, signIn, steps }.

wsQ.description: The workspaces filtered by name, owner, branch or environment.

signingIn.description: The VB Studio window is open to sign in: refreshed again once it is closed.
